lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd4Si8Bi4 (reduced formula NdSi2Bi) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Bi and Nd centers 10-neighbor environments, while Si centers show 9- and 10-neighbor environments. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Bi and Nd 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Nd and Si 10-vertex polyhedra.
